description: Real four-vault demo AgentTokenVault basket (issue #560). Three Base-only agent-economy tokens curated by ADMIN_ROLE: BNKR (V3), JUNO (V4), ROBOTMONEY (V4/Aerodrome). Token addresses live here, never in Solidity source (contracts/vaults/AgentTokenVault.sol). The deploy script (contracts/script/DeployDemoExtraVaults.s.sol) seeds devnet stand-in ERC20s + stub pools at deploy time. Ordering is load-bearing: AgentTokenVault.shortlist() returns tokens in this order.

devnet.description: Stand-in ERC20 + pool addresses for devnet/test deploys. The demo deploy script (DeployDemoExtraVaults.s.sol) creates DemoBasketToken + DemoUsdcPool stubs at run-time and wires them with per-asset venue adapters (DemoV3SwapRouter for BNKR, DemoV4SwapRouter for JUNO, DemoAerodromeRouter for ROBOTMONEY). Token/pool/adapter addresses are dynamically assigned per run; this config documents the expected structure and venue assignment only.

shortlist.note: Uses built-in SWAP_ROUTER path (DemoV3SwapRouter on devnet). No per-asset adapter (adapter = address(0)).
Uses UniswapV4SwapAdapter wrapping DemoV4SwapRouter on devnet.
Uses AerodromeSwapAdapter wrapping the Slipstream-compatible DemoAerodromeRouter on devnet. swapFee carries the CL pool tick spacing.
